summary.text: Hilda E. Santiago was elected in 2012 to represent Meriden's 84th Assembly District and serves as Deputy Speaker Pro Tempore.

paragraphs.text: She was born in Naranjito, Puerto Rico, raised in New York City, and graduated from Orville H. Platt High School in Meriden.
She earned a Bachelor of Science in Secondary Education from Southern Connecticut State University.
She was appointed to the Meriden City Council in 1996 and won an open seat on it in 2005.
